law: REGISTRATION of E-Q26 — axis algebra (ORCH-R25 lane T16-b): does the noul question-map space support ANALOGY ARITHMETIC? Ten sealed compositions v(a) - v(b) + v(c) built purely from the SEALED E-Q22 noul vectors; the question is whether the composed vector retrieves the analogy target d. Every coordinate is a named, diagnosable question — axis algebra where the arithmetic is interpretable axis by axis. ZERO new embed calls (pure re-analysis of sealed vectors + live queries). The r24 ideas battery's cheapest candidate (I-2, novelty 3.5 / feasibility 4).
provenance_of_the_question: The r24 ideas battery (I-2, the operator's standing challenge) + the deep-embedding round's vector stockpile: 40 sealed noul vectors (E-Q22) whose space supports retrieval at 0.80. Word2vec's king - man + woman = queen is the ancestor; nobody (per the prior-art pass) has run analogy arithmetic on QA-score embeddings, where each coordinate is a named question.

design_frozen.vectors: the E-Q22 noul arm (N), 20 records, sealed in situations/embedding_r24/eval_eq22_results.json
design_frozen.compositions: Ten, deterministic, frozen: FIVE ANALOGY compositions (a and d same family, b and c same other family: comp = v(a) - v(b) + v(c), target d) + FIVE TRANSLATION compositions (a and d DIFFERENT families: does subtracting one family's offset and adding another's carry the record across?). Family order N,P,Q,A; record order within family by id. The exact 10 tuples are derived by the rule: for i in 0..4, analogy_i uses (a = F[i%4][0], d = F[i%4][(i//4)+1] or F[(i+1)%4][0] fallback, b = F[(i+1)%4][0], c = F[(i+1)%4][1]) and translation_i uses (a = F[i%4][0], d = F[(i+2)%4][0], b = F[(i+1)%4][0], c = F[(i+3)%4][0]) — emitted verbatim into the results file before scoring.
design_frozen.scoring: Per composition: the composed vector queries LIVE Vectorize (arm-filtered eq22N, topK 20) over the 20 sealed records; HIT = target d is top-1; also rank(d) and cosine(comp, d). Hypothesis calls vs the PERMUTATION NULL: 1000 draws, record-vector labels shuffled, same 10 compositions re-scored (in code, local cosine — the null is a label-shuffle, the live round-trip is for the real arm).
design_frozen.zero_new_calls: no typesafe calls; ~10 live Vectorize queries (free tier)

floors.F1: the composition tuples are emitted by the frozen rule and sealed in the results file before any scoring
floors.F2: the vectors are the sealed E-Q22 noul vectors, byte-identical on recompute from the eval file
floors.F3: all 10 compositions scored through the LIVE arm-filtered round-trip
floors.F4: the permutation null computed in code with seed 20261019, 1000 draws

hypotheses.H1_analogy: analogy hit rate > the permutation null's mean analogy hit rate + 2 standard deviations
hypotheses.H3_analogy_vs_translation: analogy hit rate >= translation hit rate (family offsets subtract cleanly; cross-family carry is harder)
hypotheses.C21: the question-map space supports analogy arithmetic — LIVES iff H1 AND H2

predictions.P1: analogy hit rate in [0.2, 0.6] (above null ~0.1, below dense-encoder word-analogy rates — 8 axes carry structure but coarsely)
predictions.P3: translation hit rate <= analogy hit rate (H3 direction), with translation still above null (the offsets carry SOME family geometry)
predictions.P4: the axis-wise autopsy shows the composed vector's family axes (the family-defining ones) move toward d's values while the null axes wobble

falsifier: ANY of F1-F4 breached; compositions edited after emission; the null computed on anything but label shuffles; a hit claimed without the live round-trip.
budget: $0.00 LLM (zero calls) + free-tier queries. Part of the r25 round budget.
